proposal.summary: An exported DialerActivity in com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted (≤ 1.0.1) allows any installed app (without permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent to that component.
proposal.cwe_quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.

AV.quote: by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.

I.quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls

A.quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify whether com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity is exported and lacks permission checks; if so, restrict export or require an appropriate Android permission and release a patch. Confirm reproduction steps and affected versions.

evidence_quotes.quote: The com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted application through 1.0.1 for Android

enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.

evidence_quotes.claim: Attack vector via crafted intent to DialerActivity
evidence_quotes.quote: by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.
